surface.$description: Panels on the page background: tables, forms, specimen boxes

text.$description: Body text and secondary text (captions, sources) on light backgrounds

heading.$description: Headings and running text on light backgrounds

link.$description: Links on light backgrounds; always underlined, so they differ from headings

surface-subtle.$description: Subtle bases on light backgrounds: table headers, highlighted rows (dark-gray 10.64:1, dark-green 5.24:1)

surface-card.$description: Large content boxes and cards; text inside is white

border.$description: Decorative borders; too faint for control boundaries (1.37:1 on soft-white)

border-control.$description: Boundaries of inputs and other controls (4.35:1 on soft-white; WCAG 1.4.11 needs 3:1)

focus-ring.$description: Keyboard focus on light backgrounds; on slate-green and dark-green use white

cta.$description: Primary call to action only; never for large areas

on-cta.$description: Text and icons on signal-orange (5.61:1); white fails contrast
